【原视频简介】
For the final episode of the series, we’re in Michigan’s capital city, Lansing, heading to Meat Southern BBQ to take on their massive “Boss Logg” Challenge!

Meat Southern BBQ & Carnivore Cuisine has been cooking up Southern-style barbecue since 2012. The restaurant was started by pitmaster Sean Johnson, who turned his passion for smoking meats for friends and family into one of Lansing’s best-known BBQ spots! Meat is known for making its food from scratch daily and for its laid-back, quirky atmosphere filled with rock ’n’ roll and sci-fi memorabilia. Over the years, the restaurant has earned numerous local awards and even received wide attention after being featured on Food Network’s Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives.

The “Boss Logg” Challenge features a giant 18-layer sandwich loaded with smoked turkey, pulled chicken, pulled pork, beef brisket, bacon, multiple layers of fries, cheddar, American and pepper jack cheese, gravy, hot garlic sauce, jalapeños, and a fried egg. You'll also have to finish a side of your choice along with a massive order of their made-to-order mac and cheese loaded with two additional ingredients. If you have can finish all the food within 45 minutes, you'll get the $64 meal free, you’ll receive a T-shirt, a drink, and your photo on their Wall of Fame!
